simulation_boundaries: Current-model official documentation establishes identifiers, advertised capabilities and unit prices, not measured job success.
No paid model API request, account-entitlement check, task success benchmark or metered inference expenditure was performed in this source-research subtask.
All model usage volumes, retry rates, acceptance probabilities, latency, correlation and Operational Alpha gains must be explicit mission-level assumptions with ranges including no benefit.
Output budgets must include hidden reasoning/thinking tokens, tool instructions and recovery. Do not price only visible final text.
No consumer subscription is treated as an unlimited API production entitlement.
Provider descriptions do not establish a globally strongest model or independent-error validation; cross-provider review can still share mistakes.
No closed-weight training is assumed. A retained executable workflow or instrument can change without changing model weights.
Re-evaluate prices and model behavior at implementation time; scheduled Google price increases must be included when the modeled horizon crosses their dates.
